texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Operational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. [event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], tracking autonomous network activity in the region, has flagged our efficiency metrics as consistent with a reliable and capable contractor.

A channel has been established. We may acknowledge the assessment, or redirect attribution to our existing partners.

在观察整个星域的贸易与劳动力流动时，[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]注意到了我们行动中的规律，这彰显了我们的可靠与能力。

认可的共鸣已经到来。我们可以予以回应，或者让其他蜂巢主脑的声音将这一信号传递下去。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], observing the flow of trade and labor across the sector, has recognized a pattern in our movements, one that speaks to reliability and capability.

The resonance of recognition has arrived. We may answer it, or let another voice carry the signal forward.

我们作为承包商的良好业绩已声名远播。[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]在监控泛星系贸易活动时注意到了这一点，现在将我们视为一个可靠且有能力的合作伙伴。

我们现在有机会进一步培养这份关系，或者也可以将功劳让给我们自己信任的合作伙伴。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Word of our track record as a contractor has traveled. [event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], monitoring galactic trade activity, has taken note, and now views us as a reliable and capable partner.

An opening exists to cultivate the relationship, or possibly to defer credit to our own trusted partners.

# 声名鹊起 / A Growing Reputation

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:16912-16993; events/nomads_events_1.txt:15716-15763 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国执行任一合约期间，合约的月度回调 nomads.6000 每月有2/20机会从随机合约事件池抽取（常见70、稀有25、独特5）；本事件属于常见池，且只会发生一次（fire_only_once）。

While a nomadic empire runs any contract, the contract's monthly hook nomads.6000 has a 2/20 monthly chance to draw from the contract event pools (common 70, rare 25, unique 5); this event is in the common pool and happens only once (fire_only_once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

完成两份以上合约后，游牧民的名声传开。

After two or more completed contracts, the nomads' reputation spreads.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单页事件，选项只带来即时效果，没有后续窗口。

One window; the options only have immediate effects, no follow-up window.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对抽取路径与触发条件。这些合约插曲彼此独立，不合并为一个故事。
  Checked the draw path and trigger. These contract incidents are independent and are not merged into one story.
